notes: Phobos Agriculture cooking recipes (Agriculture 0.40.0): what a Hearth-2 turns one portion into. Each recipe takes one item and gives one item of the same mass; cooking adds and removes nothing, and its electricity leaves as room heat. The Hearth-2 draws 2 kW while cooking, so seconds fixes the energy. Published revisions are frozen (frozen-process-recipes.json): change a recipe by adding a revision. A portion in the cooker is cooked by the recipe that names its item, so two recipes may not take the same item.

hearth-potatoes.notes: Hearth revision 1, unchanged since Agriculture 0.2.0: one 0.4 kg portion of raw potatoes into one cooked portion over 90 seconds at 2 kW (0.05 kWh).
